mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 0.5 percentage point or greater increase in the unemployment rate over the prior 3 months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate earnings expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where UNRATE rises > 0.5pp (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2% or greater YoY decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over the prior 6 months signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces revenue growth for S&P 500 constituents and produces negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where RSAFS falls > 2% YoY (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 1% or greater YoY increase in the Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) over the prior 6 months signals a broad-based acceleration in manufacturing output, which boosts earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline in periods where INDPRO rises > 1% YoY (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous 0.3 percentage point or greater increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and a 1% or greater YoY decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over the prior 3 months signals a synchronized deterioration in labor and demand conditions, which reduces earnings and growth expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.3pp AND RSAFS falls > 1% YoY in 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where both UNRATE rises > 0.3pp AND RSAFS falls > 1% YoY (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 0.5 percentage point or greater increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the prior 3 months signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5pp (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 5% or greater YoY increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over the prior 6 months signals a strong consumer demand environment, which boosts revenue growth for S&P 500 constituents and drives positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline in periods where RSAFS rises > 5% YoY (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 0.5 percentage point or greater decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) combined with a 1% or greater YoY increase in the Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) over the prior 3 months signals a synchronized improvement in labor and supply conditions, which raises earnings and growth expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls > 0.5pp AND INDPRO rises > 1% YoY in 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline in periods where both UNRATE falls > 0.5pp AND INDPRO rises > 1% YoY (t-test p > 0.05).
